body: Scoped from the determinability probe (output/determinability-probe/findings.md). Population = 589 heuristic gold cols (349 ac-03 + 240 header-heuristic); 342 strongly-adjudicated tier is control-only. Core mechanic: UPGRADE provisional heuristic labels to verified (append-only per 0095), never overwrite a verified fact. Independence fix: mix Claude panels + Qwen3:32b (probe found 3 Claude panels share priors). Integrity proof against goalpost-moving: panels blind to the model + report correction model-agree vs model-disagree split (probe: 19 panel-third > 7 panel-agrees-model => corrections are NOT model-flattering). Deliverables: gold v2 (author-gated), honest re-baseline with decomposed delta, taxonomy-gap list, contested-set confidence bands for the analyst answer.

Ollama/Qwen retired (2026-06-16); no non-Anthropic API reachable. ac-02 revised: Sonnet alone does NOT solve independence (same Claude family). Use line/capacity diversity (Opus+Sonnet+Fable via Agent model overrides; Fable is the most-independent reachable line) + methodological independence (per-panel distinct value samples + adversarial challenge pass). Panel agreement is now an UPPER BOUND on determinability; the anti-goalpost-moving guarantee rests on ac-04's family-independent controls (negative control, author spot-check, correction model-agree/disagree split). Add a true cross-vendor panel (GPT/Gemini) if a key becomes available.

PHASE 1 COMPLETE + author-accepted. 4 blind panels (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku + Opus adversarial) over 260 ac-03 cols + 28 controls. Verdicts: 160 CONFIRM / 47 PROPOSE / 53 CONTESTED. Applied 23 corrections (recommended set: non-debatable PROPOSE, conf>=0.75) -> eval/gold/gold_corpus_v2.tsv (append-only, old label in provenance, taxonomy v0.6.31). Re-baseline: shipped model v1 738/931=0.793 -> v2 741/931=0.796 (+3: 8 helped model, 5 HURT it, 10 neutral). INTEGRITY: negative control 82% confirm; 37/47 corrections disagree with model -> not goalpost-moving. Leakage 0 overlap. FOLLOW-UPS (open): phase-2 header-heuristic tier (240), 34 deferred debatable proposals (18 numeric->alnum, 5 TLD->categorical, + conf<0.75), datetime constrained-vocab re-run (CONTESTED inflated by iso/calendar_date/date vocab noise), wire gold_corpus_v2 as default score_gold_anchor.py path. ac-07 taxonomy-gap: NONE surfaced as 'other' this round (panels mapped to existing types); the deferred debatable set + datetime re-run are the real follow-ups. Substrate: output/gold-readjudication/.
